# Cincinnati Nature Center

> 1,800-acre nature preserve offering hiking trails, educational programs, camps, and conservation activities for families and outdoor enthusiasts across the Cincinnati region.

Cincinnati Nature Center operates two main locations—Rowe Woods and Long Branch Farm & Trails—providing year-round outdoor recreation, environmental education, and community access programs. The center serves families, scouts, schools, and nature clubs while maintaining trails and natural habitats in the greater Cincinnati area.

## Key Topics

- Hiking trails
- Nature education
- Summer camps
- Family programs
- Scout programs

## Plan Your Visit

- [Visit Us](https://www.cincynature.org/visit/visit-us): Visitor information, admission pricing, hours, and pet policies
- [Trail Closures & Updates](http://cincynature.org/visit/trail-closures-updates): Trail closures and weather updates for Rowe Woods and Long Branch locations
- [Our Trails](https://cincynature.org/visit/our-trails): Trail maps, ratings, and conditions for Rowe Woods and Long Branch
- [Bring Your Pet](https://cincynature.org/visit/bring-your-pet): Pet policy and dog registration guidelines for Cincinnati Nature Center

## Programs & Activities

- [Things to Do](https://www.cincynature.org/things-to-do): Programs, camps, and activities for all ages at Cincinnati Nature Center
- [CincyNature Camp](https://cincynature.org/things-to-do/cincynature-camp): Summer camp registration and outdoor education for children
- [Children's Saturday Programs](https://cincynature.org/things-to-do/childrens-saturday-programs): Saturday nature education programs for children ages 4-12
- [Hike for Your Health](https://cincynature.org/things-to-do/hike-for-your-health): Health and wellness hiking program with trail challenge and stamps
- [Join a Club](https://cincynature.org/things-to-do/join-a-club): Astronomy, camera, and nature clubs for Cincinnati Nature Center members

## Education & Groups

- [Plan a Field Trip](https://www.cincynature.org/education/plan-a-field-trip): School field trip planning and student outdoor learning programs
- [Scout Programs](https://www.cincynature.org/scout-programs): Scout badge programs and nature hikes for youth organizations
- [Bring Your Group](https://cincynature.org/visit/bring-your-group): Group visit policies, scout programs, and guidelines for Cincinnati Nature Center

## Membership & Access

- [Membership](https://www.cincynature.org/membership): Membership plans and benefits for Cincinnati Nature Center access
- [Nature For All](https://www.cincynature.org/about/nature-for-all): Community access program with SNAP/WIC discounts and youth opportunities

## Shop & Support

- [The Nature Shop](https://natureshop.cincynature.org): The Nature Shop merchandise and conservation apparel for Cincinnati Nature Center

## Optional

- [Garden Tour: Noteworthy Natives](https://www.cincynature.org/garden-tour-noteworthy-natives): Self-guided native plant garden tour and fundraiser event
- [Home](https://www.cincynature.org): Cincinnati Nature Center homepage with 1,800 acres, trails, and conservation programs
